title: White House Press Secy Karoline Leavitt: US To Control Venezuelan Oil Sales Indefinitely | N18G
text: White House Press Secy Karoline Leavitt: US To Control Venezuelan Oil Sales Indefinitely | N18GWhite House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt addressed the media regarding the Trump administration's policy on Venezuela following a 'historic' military operation. Leavitt confirmed that the US government has begun marketing Venezuelan crude oil to the global marketplace, with proceeds settling in US-controlled accounts. She stated that the decisions of Venezuela's interim authorities 'are going to continue to be dictated by the United States of America.'
